title: Absurd prices attached to a consumer barcode: a $4,898.99 pallet row on a carton, and a 19 cent row
comment: DEFECTS row D-267, sweep Family 2 A6: Walmart '946ml | 12/case | pallet of 60 cases' at $4,898.99 (6 rows over $200, 12 under 30 cents). Planted as rows: one over $2,000 and one at 19 cents, both on baseline products.
ifMissed: A plausibility band per catalogue category (and per unit price) on every priced row.
